notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We have pushed a new hotfix update for the "full" version of the game. 

If you have the game already installed and patched, you can download a small hotfix patch in the following link for your language:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gZBvsyIYQZtuow9kKl7y11PhHB7sMDr_?usp=sharing
Move the www fodler extracted from the patch to your game folder and merge them.

If you just bought the game, simply go to https://saikeystudios.com/steam-patches/ and grab the full free patch there.

Patch v1.2 Change Log:
- Fixed several untranslated texts
- Fixed crash in T.Chinese version of the game
- Multiple image fixes
- Added missing features:
     Improved Recollection room
     Added missing sex sprites and animation
     Added new items and features
